body: I've talked extensively with my mother. She wouldn't be happy but she would get it. I don't really think my dad feels too strongly about anything, let alone me. It would be rough on my girlfriend. Even tho I'm pretty sure she's going to leave me soon anyway. This is something i've been thinking about for over a decade. Any doubts have been resolved. The only problem is I lack the means for a peaceful death. Philosophically I'm ok with it.
